composition.serve_who: This sheet serves the Termodinamica VRV18E1 air-conditioning installation: the title identifies a marine inverter air-conditioning wiring schematic, the left side shows two engine-room VRV18E1 compressor/heat-exchanger units with dedicated seawater pumps, the center shows room-named MRMAXI fan-coil loads, and the right-side insets detail their terminals, touchscreens, sensors, bridges, and bus connections. Compressor and room-load functions attach to their named equipment; the Main Switchboard feed, LAN, and Termodinamica bus/control topology remain infrastructure.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Termodinamica VRV18E1 Aircon Unit 1 — engine room PORT, including TMD100 seawater cooling pump
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The upper-left load is explicitly labeled “VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT”; the register defines compressor unit 1 as the VRV18E1 compressor, heat exchanger, and seawater cooling pump assembly.

functions.label: Power the port refrigeration unit and its seawater cooling pump
functions.what_it_does: Supplies the port VRV18E1 refrigeration unit from the vessel AC system and lets that unit feed its dedicated TMD100 seawater pump for condenser cooling.

flow_scenarios.path: Main Switchboard → B1 open → port VRV18E1 and its TMD100 pump unpowered; compressor protective earth remains bonded only to the specified independent anode/zinc.

Main Switchboard 230 VAC → breaker B1, 40 A, C or D curve → 3-core 6 mm² L/N/PE feeder → port VRV18E1 → drawn red 3-core 1.5 mm² pump supply → dedicated TMD100 seawater pump → neutral/PE return; compressor ground wire separately terminates at an independent anode/zinc and must not connect to another device.

facts: Two separately drawn Main Switchboard branches feed the port and starboard VRV18E1 units.
Each branch has a breaker identified B1, rated 40 A, C or D curve.
Each compressor feeder is specified as 230 VAC, L+N+PE, 3 × 6 mm².
The sheet does not identify the upstream bus section or distinguish the two repeated B1 labels beyond PORT/STBD placement.

infrastructure.system_name: Termodinamica air-conditioning control, local power, and monitoring network
facts: The Switch BUS Box joins drawn BUS MASTER LINE 1 from the port VRV18E1 and BUS MASTER LINE 2 from the starboard VRV18E1 to the magenta BUS SLAVE topology.
Two Touch Screen Interface devices are shown at Addr.1, each rated 10 W at 24 VDC; Touch Screen 7 is drawn to the upper interface/network.
A TMD Internet Interface rated 80 W at 24 VDC connects by Ethernet to the Internet Router and into the Termodinamica control installation.
AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS modules are shown at Addr.31, model QI-50-V-485, rated 5 W at 24 VDC; their detailed current-sensing conductor arrangement is shown in the lower-right inset area.
TMD Bridge modules are shown at Addr.32, rated 5 W at 24 VDC, with RS485 Modbus RTU.
Room air handlers have separately drawn 230 VAC drops and local thermostat leads; the source panel and branch protective devices for those 230 VAC drops are not identified on this sheet.
Right-side insets define touchscreen, VRV terminal block, air-handler, master/slave, current-sensor, and Switch BUS Box connection arrangements.
Bus cable conductor sizes vary with route length and PCB count as listed in the sheet notes; these notes belong to the air-conditioning distribution infrastructure.

infrastructure.system_name: Vessel Ethernet/LAN serving the air-conditioning remote interface
facts: An Internet Router has two drawn Ethernet LAN links: one to the TMD Internet Interface and one to Touch Screen 7.
Ethernet cable is specified as UTP CAT.5.
No connection beyond the router is drawn on this sheet, so no WAN or wider-vessel network path is inferred.

discarded_as_clutter: Drawing title, title block, revision/date, drafter and verifier fields
Key-line color samples after their cable meanings were incorporated
Repeated right-side inset titles where the detail merely repeats the main topology
Generic “FANCOIL NOTES” heading with no legible operational content
Duplicate upper/lower labels for Addr.1, Addr.31, and Addr.32 treated as repeated installation infrastructure rather than separate equipment nodes
Legend spelling artifacts such as “lenght” and extraction variants “SxythSense/Sxythsense”
Decorative company logo and sheet border
uncertainties: Exact terminal numbers and any built-in replaceable fused-terminal positions in the small right-side detail insets are not cleanly readable at the supplied resolution; no terminal-specific loop or fuse claim is made. Capture those terminal numbers from the native drawing before terminal-level troubleshooting.
The sheet labels both compressor protective devices as B1; whether these are duplicated local designations or one panel identifier repeated across two branches is not resolved here.
The source panel, breaker/fuse identifiers, and return terminals for the fan-coil 230 VAC branches are not identified on this sheet.

The detailed direction and measured conductor assignment of each Addr.31 current-sensor connection cannot be walked confidently from the raster; only its drawn monitoring role and model/address/rating are retained.
Bus note thresholds contain compact notation for PCB counts that is not fully unambiguous in the raster, so cable-size options are not converted into exact route requirements.
